name: Ranked bars
description: Horizontal bars sorted from largest to smallest, values at the end of each bar.
use_when: Rank items on one measure (regions, products, causes). Best with 3 to 12 items.
limits: One measure only; sort the data before filling.
fill_notes: Chart: categories + one series, sorted descending.
tags: ranking bars horizontal sorted top leaderboard compare items

name: KPI cards with change
description: Three cards with a figure, its label and the change against a reference.
use_when: A compact scorecard inside a slide that also carries text or a chart.
limits: Three figures; for more use layout L-39.
fill_notes: Text: Value n, Label n, Change n.
tags: kpi cards figures change delta variation scorecard metrics
fields: Value 1|text|5; Label 1|text|37; Change 1|text|45|optional; Value 2|text|5|optional; Label 2|text|37|optional; Change 2|text|45|optional; Value 3|text|5|optional; Label 3|text|37|optional; Change 3|text|45|optional

name: Stage-gate
description: Four stages as bars separated by diamond decision gates, with criteria under each gate.
use_when: Development or investment process with go / no-go decisions.
limits: Four stages and three gates; gate criteria in a few words.
fill_notes: Stage n, Gate n, Gate n criteria.
tags: stage gate phase gate go no go decision milestones innovation development
fields: Stage 1|text|60|role=card; Stage 1 text|text|60|optional; Gate 1|text|4|default,role=label; Gate 1 criteria|text|60|optional; Stage 2|text|60|role=card; Stage 2 text|text|60|optional; Gate 2|text|4|default,role=label; Gate 2 criteria|text|60|optional; Stage 3|text|60|role=card; Stage 3 text|text|60|optional; Gate 3|text|4|default,role=label; Gate 3 criteria|text|60|optional; Stage 4|text|60|role=card; Stage 4 text|text|60|optional

name: Now, next, later
description: Three columns from dark to light: what we do now, next and later, as short lists.
use_when: Product or programme roadmap without committed dates.
limits: Three to five items per column.
fill_notes: Column n heading, Column n items (bullets).
tags: now next later roadmap product priorities horizon backlog
fields: Column 1 heading|text|25|default,role=label; Column 1 items|bullets|60; Column 2 heading|text|25|default,role=label; Column 2 items|bullets|60; Column 3 heading|text|25|default,role=label; Column 3 items|bullets|60
